text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O crosses the finish line! Under immense pressure,
she delivered a magnificent run without giving an inch!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She proved the dignity of a true, orthodox Umamusume
here in the spring at Yodo!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, fufufufu...
Bwahaha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Running this well in the Tenno Sho (Spring)... no one will ever look down on me again!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, members of the previous generation!
And you as well, Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O makes her stand here!
A valiant step forward toward the throne of the "Century's End Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, did you see that?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, do not miss a moment. You are my
personal historian—the one who records each and every glory.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Burn every fiber of my being into your eyes!
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass, this running form is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's even more impactful than before.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Opera O-san is amazing...
Her running is almost terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'll manage to make it in time for
our promised Takarazuka Kinen. But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Can I really race against someone like that?
Hauuu..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is nothing to fear, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyawawaaa, it's coming right at us!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's hesitation, TM Opera O leaped
over the railing and dove right into the middle
of the spectator seats.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am strong. And that is precisely why
you have no reason to be frightened.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As the star of the show,
all I have to do is take all those feelings head-on with a bang.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You were the one who wished to run alongside me
and cross blades, were you not?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then prepare yourself well and come at me. At the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san...
To think you care about me that much...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Yes! Well then... I'll gladly take you up on that...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why, my dear Trainer!
Our next race shall be the 'Takarazuka Kinen'!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before we face the hero of the previous generation, let us first accept Doto's
challenge! Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, TM Opera O delivered results at the Tenno Sho,
and her next race was set for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everything seems to be going smoothly, but...

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You really did whatever you pleased, didn't you,
TM Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I thought it was a fluke at first, but... maybe I need to rethink that. Next time...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The real contest starts here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Until now, those who didn't know Opera O-san's true strength were complacent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, Opera O proved it today.
A power so evident that nobody could deny it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: They won't let me run easily anymore.
choice_data_list: Will they mark you more heavily?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Many Umamusume will likely devise strategies to defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps they might work together
to box her in...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That applies to everyone.
To me, to Spe-chan, to El—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She found something to break through that obstacle, and she overcame it...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It comes down to whether you can do the same thing.
To Opera O-san, who loves the spotlight and will be marked even more heavily.
